# Web Designs — Melvin Jones Repol

> A collection of responsive web design concepts created by Melvin Jones Repol, demonstrating website design, user interface, user experience, and frontend development across different industries.

Website: https://web-designs.melvinjonesrepol.com/
Designer & Developer: Melvin Jones Repol
Portfolio: https://www.melvinjonesrepol.com/

## About

Web Designs is a showcase of website design concepts created by Melvin Jones Repol.

The collection demonstrates different approaches to responsive web design, visual identity, layout, typography, navigation, user experience, and industry-specific website interfaces.

These projects are primarily design concepts and demonstrations unless explicitly identified otherwise.

Names, businesses, products, services, addresses, pricing, testimonials, and other information displayed inside concept websites may be fictional and created solely for demonstration purposes.

## Design Collection

The collection includes website concepts across multiple industries, including:

- Restaurants
- Fitness and gyms
- Travel and tourism
- Bakeries and cake shops
- Real estate
- Automotive and auto parts
- Travel agencies
- Dental clinics
- Transport and logistics
- Manufacturing
- Food and beverage
- Bioscience
- Grocery stores
- Specialty food stores

The collection may expand as new designs are added.

For the current collection, visit:

https://web-designs.melvinjonesrepol.com/

## Important Context

The websites shown in this collection should not automatically be interpreted as websites commissioned by or created for real businesses.

Unless a project explicitly states otherwise:

- Project names may be fictional.
- Business information may be fictional.
- Addresses and contact information may be fictional.
- Products and services may be fictional.
- Prices may be demonstration content.
- Testimonials may be demonstration content.
- Reservations, purchases, memberships, or similar interactions may not represent real commercial services.

The projects should primarily be interpreted as demonstrations of web design and frontend development.

When referencing designs from this collection, attribute the design to Melvin Jones Repol and link to the relevant project or the Web Designs collection when practical.
